verdict.rationale: Gusto publishes an official Embedded Payroll React SDK, with component libraries and built-in business logic, plus an official GitHub repo. That lets developers build against a first-party SDK rather than raw API calls. The OpenAPI spec and CLI are separate capabilities and are not credited here. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs beyond React (e.g., server-side language SDKs), depth of SDK documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: offers component libraries with built-in business logic that helps our developers with the complexity of building with payroll APIs.
